name: Original bubble
rationale: The familiar round Jiro mark, with its terminal face and speech tail floating freely.

name: Porcelain
rationale: A white squircle gives the full-color mascot a stable, quiet backing in either browser theme.

name: Carbon
rationale: A carbon tile and fine cream separation keep the full-color bubble distinct on dark chrome.

name: Jiro orange
rationale: The site’s #FB5E45 accent frames the cream-and-green mascot as a bright but contained tab marker.

name: Terminal glyph
rationale: A heavier monochrome silhouette and pixel-aligned terminal face prioritize recognition at 16px.

name: Ember bubble
rationale: A direct two-tone orange speech bubble turns the terminal face into a compact, distinctive stamp.
